screens.title: 1 · Entregas, where Projetos was
screens.why: The three forces on one screen: goals on top, the agenda under them, the queue they compete for.

pins.label: Tab: Entregas
pins.text: Replaces Projetos in the same spot. Icon: Phosphor stack (deliveries piled up). Tempo · Entregas · Menu stay three tabs.

pins.label: Search
pins.text: Opens Todas as entregas with the field focused (screen 2).

pins.label: Goal card
pins.text: What it measures, the month, days left, the amount. Bar: delivered (accent) + queued and due in time (accent wash). Here even the whole queue leaves R$ 1.870 uncovered.

pins.label: Nova meta
pins.text: A quiet pill; the accent stays on the + (screen 5).

pins.label: The agenda
pins.text: The schedule force in one line: time the queue has due this month against the free hours left. 11h15 needed, 26h free: room for more clients.

pins.label: Shelves
pins.text: Catalogue categories filter the queue. Todas by default.

pins.label: A delivery
pins.text: Name · value; kind · time (or worked of total, or steps) · due day. Bar once work has started. Order is priority; hold to drag, as in Lista.
Writes a delivery (screens 3–4). Same place as on every tab.

pins.label: More goals
pins.text: Goals scroll sideways: active first, then future ones, drawn quiet with their start day.

screens.title: 2 · Every delivery, searched
screens.why: The tab shows the top 5 of the queue; the rest, and what was delivered, live here.

pins.label: Search
pins.text: Reads name, kind and shelf: “mapa” finds every natal chart, “Camila” everything for her.

pins.label: Shelves
pins.text: The same filter as the tab.

pins.label: Na fila
pins.text: Queue matches, in priority order.

pins.label: Feitas
pins.text: Delivered, newest first, with the day. They are what fills the goals.

screens.title: 3 · New delivery: pick from the catalogue
screens.why: Most deliveries are a kind she already sells; picking one fills time, value and splitting.

pins.label: Type or search
pins.text: Filters the catalogue as she types; a name that matches nothing becomes a loose delivery.

pins.label: Editar
pins.text: Opens the catalogue's own page (a later delivery).

pins.label: Kind's defaults
pins.text: Each kind carries its usual time and price. A post has no price: it counts towards a count goal.

pins.label: Avulsa, at the end
pins.text: Last row: “Uma entrega avulsa”, no kind, time given by hand. Today's projects become these.

pins.label: Category → kind
pins.text: Two levels: the shelf (Atendimentos, Conteúdo, Produtos) and the kind on it.

screens.title: 4 · New delivery: who it is for
screens.why: Only the name and the day are left to write; every other row came from the kind.

pins.label: Kind tag
pins.text: Shelf · kind; Trocar goes back to the catalogue.

pins.label: Name
pins.text: Prefilled with the kind; she adds who it is for.

pins.label: Tempo total
pins.text: From the kind, changeable. Later, the sum of its subtasks when it has them.

pins.label: No dia
pins.text: Inteira, or Blocos de 1h: the timeline takes a piece a day instead of pushing the whole 3h to tomorrow.

pins.label: Valor
pins.text: From the price; what counts towards the money goal.

pins.label: Conta para
pins.text: Worked out, not picked: the money goal of the due month, or the count goal of its kind.

pins.label: Where in the queue
pins.text: No topo or No fim. Finer order is a drag on the tab.

pins.label: Pôr na fila
pins.text: The one accent action.

screens.title: 5 · New goal
screens.why: The smallest goal that says something: a number, per week or month, now or next month.

pins.label: Medir
pins.text: Faturamento (reais) or Quantidade (of one kind from the catalogue, e.g. 3 posts).

pins.label: Quanto
pins.text: The target.

pins.label: Por
pins.text: Semana or Mês; it repeats every stretch.

pins.label: Quando
pins.text: Agora, or next month: a future goal waits, drawn quiet among the goals.

pins.label: Read back
pins.text: The goal as a sentence, so what will be measured is never in doubt.
